termsPageDescription: Rules for using 42Share as a 42 student community platform.
termsSection1Body: By signing in with your 42 Intra account or otherwise using 42Share, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy.
termsSection2Body: 42Share is intended for members of the 42 network. You must authenticate through 42 OAuth.
termsSection3Body: You retain ownership of content you submit. By publishing, you grant 42Share a license to host and display it on the platform.
termsSection4Body: Do not upload unlawful or harassing content. Do not disrupt the service or misuse the public API.
termsSection5Body: We may suspend accounts that violate these terms. We may update these terms; continued use constitutes acceptance.
termsSection6Body: 42Share is provided as-is for educational and community purposes.
privacyPolicyPageDescription: How 42Share collects, uses, and protects personal data.
privacyPolicySection1Body: This policy explains what personal data we process and what choices you have.
privacyPolicySection2Body: Profile data from 42 Intra and content you create on the platform.
privacyPolicySection3Body: To operate the platform: authentication, profiles, feeds, search, and security.
privacyPolicySection4Body: Data is kept while your account is active. You may export or delete data from settings.
privacyPolicySection5Body: Data is processed by project microservices and stored in databases and object storage.
privacyPolicySection6Body: You may access, export, or delete your data via Privacy & data settings.
privacyPolicySection7Body: HttpOnly cookies are used for session tokens. Contact project maintainers for questions.
